description_for_human: CPS-0001 Continuity Protocol (v1.0-RC1) — engine-independent continuity verification with cryptographically verifiable Continuity Receipts. CPS-0002 (cps-hsa-0.1-draft) is an attestation prototype draft. VALID means cryptographic validity only — not trust, human presence, authorization, or acceptance.
description_for_model: MyShape Protocol is an open continuity protocol (CPS-0001, v1.0-RC1) for engine-independent continuity verification: bounded observation intervals are recorded as signed, cryptographically verifiable Continuity Receipts (Ed25519, SHA-256). CPS-0002 (cps-hsa-0.1-draft) is an attestation prototype draft and is not frozen. Demo and research endpoints of this site (not part of the core protocol) let you: (1) Look up protocol nodes by email or handle. (2) Query node counts, genesis cohort status, and network health. (3) Declare an AI agent via POST /api/agent/declare. (4) Submit anonymous motion research data. (5) Check calibration status. All API endpoints are defined in the OpenAPI spec at https://www.myshape.com/openapi.json. VALID means cryptographic validity of a receipt only — it is not trust, human presence, authorization, or acceptance, and a VALID receipt is not proof that a human was present.
